The '''Sniffer Weapon Detector''' was a popular hand-held [[weapon detector]] manufactured by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]]. It was in common use throughout the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It was a small cube with a scanning panel on one side and an output screen on the opposite side.<ref name="HSCS" />
